displayPattern: Front-load washer display shows rL, or F34 on some models, during the Clean Washer cycle
meaning: Items were detected in the washer during the Clean Washer cycle. Whirlpool says rL or F34 means the drum is not empty.
causes: Clothes or other items were left in the drum when the cleaning cycle was started
diySteps: Remove all items from the drum
Restart the same cleaning cycle with the drum empty
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: rL is a load check for the Clean Washer cycle, not a fault. If the drum is empty and rL or F34 still appears, contact Whirlpool or schedule service online. For other F# E# codes, Whirlpool's step is to disconnect power for 5 minutes, reselect the cycle and press Start, and to request service if the code persists.
sourceTitle: Error Codes in Front Load Washers (Whirlpool Product Help)
